name: soft-door-box
task: Open the door, then, if possible, pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door' is the hard Existence(door_open); the order 'then' stays hard because 'if possible' scopes only the box pickup, giving the hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); 'if possible, pick up the box' is correctly the soft Existence(target_picked_up). The machine matches: final u2 on door_open, rejecting u1 on a box pickup before the door opens, and no clause is redundant or added.

texts: Open the door at least once.
Pick up the target box only after the door has been opened.
If possible, pick up the target box.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&target_picked_up) -> u1
(u0, door_open&!target_picked_up) -> u2
(u0, door_open&target_picked_up) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
